Amina (direct_count=32) → tier1 'Starter' as expected. Join fires direct notification on parent (still works, no 500). critical_code_review_comments: server.py: push_to_member deletes sub only when webpush returns keep=False; broad `except WebPushException as e` catches all — good, join never blocks (fire-and-forget asyncio.create_task).
server.py join_tartan validates team membership against tartan.teams before storing; ensures no arbitrary team strings pollute scoreboard aggregate.
server.py:1063 approaching the 700-line 'split into modules' guideline (now 1063 lines). Consider splitting push/rewards/teams into routers when file exceeds 1200.
reward_for is pure and inline in server.py; tested directly. Boundary at 10/50/100 matches spec.
GET /api/tartans/{token}/teams uses Mongo aggregation with $match team != None + $group + $sort reach desc → efficient and correct.
